## Interpretation boundary

This report records existing aggregate serving and viewing activity. It does **not** record purchased, reserved, scheduled, supplied, missed, or remedied paid opportunities. A final presentation lease, visible presentation, or qualifying impression must not be relabelled as a supplied paid opportunity. No sale, enquiry, or revenue may be inferred from a Shop open, contact action, presentation, or impression.

## Data-quality decision

- [ ] Correct community.
- [ ] Correct IANA timezone and local date.
- [ ] Full local-day coverage.
- [ ] Overnight separated from morning, afternoon, and evening.
- [ ] Aggregate response contains no raw viewer identifier.
- [ ] Financial-isolation checks pass.
- [ ] No material route, collection, or application outage.
- [ ] Raw response stored and hash verified.
